messages:
kelly-marketing: Quick sync 9LaunchPad9 runbook 1: mini ref-app + 1 webinar + short benchmark write-up. Goal: OSS-style launch post, 2 short tutorials (setup + deep-dive), webinar, and HubSpot inbound flow. Target launch week: May 6. Need owners for each deliverable.

prieto-devrel: I can own the repo and tutorials. Plan: a single repo with two folders: `tutorials/setup` (10-12 mins) and `tutorials/deep-dive` (20 mins). Will include Docker and Cloud Run examples.

kelly-marketing: Nice. Keep the repo runnable with minimal envs. @henry-eng can you provide a reproducible perf script we can reference in the post?

henry-eng: Yup. I'll run benches on three modes: hosted (api), dedicated, private (VPC). Using this script:

```
python perf_runner.py --model meta-mistral-7b --batch 4 --seq 256 --duration 180 --tag launchpad_may
```

I'll capture p50/p95 latency, throughput (tok/s), and USD per 1k tokens. Results will go in `benchmarks/launchpad_may/results.json`.

oya-product: For the narrative, let's highlight the decision flow: when to pick hosted (fastest onboarding), dedicated (predictable throughput), private (compliance). I can draft a one-paragraph POV and a 3-item checklist.

mira-ops: HubSpot plan: create form `launchpad_refapp_may` with hidden `campaign=launchpad_may` and `interest=refapp`. Routing: if annual_contract=true -> AE queue, else -> SDR queue. Also add `source=webinar` tag when they register for the live event. I'll wire webhook to `/api/marketing/inbound`.

prieto-devrel: Demo env snippet for README:

```
# minimal env
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="REDACTED"
export REDWOOD_MODEL="redwood/mistral-7b-quant"
./run_demo.sh
```

Make sure no secrets in repo. I'll add a `sample.env` file.

kelly-marketing: Webinar format suggestion: 25m demo (prieto), 10m benchmark highlights (henry), 15m audience Q&A + CTAs. We'll record and clip two socials: 1) "how to get started in 5 mins" and 2) "cost vs latency tradeoffs".

henry-eng: For the benchmark write-up I'll include a short table and a TL;DR callout: "Dedicated + caching + q3 quantization reduced unit cost by ~Z% for 256-seq compared to Hosted" 1 need to finalize Z after runs.

oya-product: For the launch post header, propose: "LaunchPad: Lightweight RefApp to run and compare inference modes". Marketing, happy to iterate copy.

kelly-marketing: Good start. Marketing will draft a short hero blurb + 3 bullets and a 600-800 word post that includes bench highlights, repo links, and sign-up CTA. Target draft by Apr 28.

mira-ops: Two routing notes: 1) Make sure webinar registrants get a follow-up email with repo link + quickstart, 2) Add a UTM tag `utm_campaign=launchpad_may` on the webinar page. I'll add both to HubSpot.

deploy-bot: CI: `launchpad-site` build scheduled for 2024-04-26T05:30:00Z -> will publish demo container to `ghcr.io/redwood/launchpad-demo`.

prieto-devrel: Question: do we want a short FAQ in the repo for common troubleshooting (OOM, quant errors, driver versions)? I can add a troubleshooting.md appendix.

henry-eng: Please add expected variance notes: "results depend on instance type, concurrency, and seq length". Also include the exact instance specs I used.

kelly-marketing: Action list (I'll add to sprint): 1) @prieto-devrel repo + runnable demo by Apr 20, 2) @henry-eng bench results & draft callouts by Apr 22, 3) @oya-product POV + launch bullets by Apr 18, 4) @mira-ops HubSpot + webhook by Apr 24, 5) marketing draft post + webinar page by Apr 28.

mira-ops: I'll also prepare a webhook test payload example in `integrations/webhook_example.json` for SDRs.

prieto-devrel: I'll include a tiny `Makefile` and `docker-compose.yml` so people can `make run` locally. Keeps friction low.

kelly-marketing: We'll use hashtags: #LaunchPad #RefApp #ProductionInference. Keep social copy short and developer-forward.

oya-product: I'll draft 3 tweet-length blurbs and 2 LinkedIn variants to test.

henry-eng: I'll aim to quantify the Z% number by Apr 22 and paste it here for the hero callout.

kelly-marketing: Thanks all 1 I'll schedule a 30m prep dry-run on May 1 and post the calendar invite. :rocket:
